effectSummary.ko: 번개 창이 축전 구체 범위 안의 적을 직접 맞히면 해당 구체에 1충전을 더합니다. 시전당 1회이며 구체의 총 3충전 상한을 공유합니다. 만료 폭발이 번개 창으로 재분류되지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: A direct Storm Spear hit inside Capacitor Orb adds 1 charge to that orb, once per cast, sharing its cap of 3. The expiry blast is never reclassified as Storm Spear.

description.ko: 8m 안에 구체 하나를 6초간 설치합니다. 1초마다 반경 3m의 최대 3명에게 D30% 번개 피해를 줍니다. 지속 중 M03을 유효 시전할 때마다 1충전, 최대 3충전을 얻고 자연 만료 시 D80%+충전당 D30% 번개 추가 폭발을 줍니다.
description.en: Place one orb within 8m for 6s. Each second, deal D30% lightning damage to up to 3 enemies within 3m. Each valid M03 cast adds one charge, up to 3. Natural expiry causes a secondary lightning blast for D80% plus D30% per charge.

description.ko: 길이 12m·폭 0.8m의 창으로 최대 5명에게 D170% 번개 피해를 줍니다. 최근 3초 안에 자신의 M03에 맞은 적을 직접 맞히면 자원 4를 시전당 한 번 회복합니다.
description.en: Pierce up to 5 enemies with a 12m-long, 0.8m-wide spear for D170% lightning damage. Restore 4 resource once per cast if a direct target was hit by your M03 within 3s.

concept: A necklace with a compact spherical cobalt capacitor pendant captured inside three thick brass conductor ribs and one short spear-shaped collector prong rising upward. Dark short chain, blue charge contained inside mineral, no external lightning.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LM43, Thunder Collector, class Mage, slot necklace.
Subject design: A necklace with a compact spherical cobalt capacitor pendant captured inside three thick brass conductor ribs and one short spear-shaped collector prong rising upward. Dark short chain, blue charge contained inside mineral, no external lightning.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: A direct Storm Spear hit inside Capacitor Orb adds 1 charge to that orb, once per cast, sharing its cap of 3. The expiry blast is never reclassified as Storm Spear.
Direct skill context: M11 Capacitor Orb — Place one orb within 8m for 6s. Each second, deal D30% lightning damage to up to 3 enemies within 3m. Each valid M03 cast adds one charge, up to 3. Natural expiry causes a secondary lightning blast for D80% plus D30% per charge.; M12 Storm Spear — Pierce up to 5 enemies with a 12m-long, 0.8m-wide spear for D170% lightning damage. Restore 4 resource once per cast if a direct target was hit by your M03 within 3s.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: 1024 by 1024 pixel square PNG requested, with genuinely native transparent alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Scale the equipment down within the square: the full object should occupy only the CENTRAL 72% of canvas width and height. Keep at least 14% completely empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides, including above crown peaks and around both weapon tips. Do not zoom in or maximize its size. Complete object, no clipping, no missing tips. This visible empty margin is essential. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
